values.note: $22 a night during the full-service summer period; fees may not be charged in early spring and late fall when no services are provided. Campers pay no day-use/boat-launch fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ste-kathryn-campground ('Camping - $22 a night'; 'Fees shown are for the summer recreation period when full services are provided. 'Day use fees will not be charged to those who have already paid for a campground campsite.'; page last updated May 5, 2026), read 2026-10-25

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ste-kathryn-campground ('Golden Age/Interagency Senior and Access Passes Accepted'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Occupy the site the first night; after 14 days move elsewhere for at least 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ste-kathryn-campground ('Reservations No reservations - first come, first serve.'; 'Camping in a developed recreation site is allowed for a period not longer than 14 days'; 'Campers must occupy the site the first night.') + recreation.gov search for 'Ste Kathryn' (no campground facility), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Full services from the Friday before Memorial Day. From October 15 there is no water or garbage service, but the campground can be used until snow limits access.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ste-kathryn-campground ('Seasons of Use May 15 – October 15'; 'The campground is scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day.'; 'Reduced services beginning October 15, 2026, no water or garbage services will be provided. Visitors can use the facility until snow conditions reduce access.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One loop of 24 drive-in sites that take tents, trailers and motor homes, each naturally screened, with table, fire ring, lantern post and parking spur. Eight people, two motorized vehicles and one RV or trailer per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ste-kathryn-campground ('This one loop campground provides 24 drive-in camping sites that can accommodate tents, trailers and motor homes.' 'No. of Sites: 24'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Three sets of vault toilets and two hand pumps for drinking water.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ste-kathryn-campground ('Three sets of toilets and two hand pumps for drinking water are located in the campground.' 'Three sets of vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground on 151-acre Lake Ste. Kathryn (25 ft deep), 8 mi south of Sidnaw on Sidnaw Road (Kenton Ranger District, Iron County). Boat ramp beside the campground; small beach and picnic area near site 13; the Deer Marsh Interpretive Trail starts at the east entrance. Run by Camp Host, LLC. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 5, 2026): $22/night (confirmed), Senior/Access accepted (new), first-come only, no recreation.gov listing (confirmed), 14-day limit (new), season May 15 - Oct 15 with reduced services after (new), 24 drive-in sites for tents, trailers and motor homes (confirmed), vault toilets + hand pumps (confirmed). Hookups not stated (rustic). Operator Camp Host, LLC. No Ottawa NF alert or order names Sidnaw Road or the campground. Note corrected (8 mi S of Sidnaw, not 'near Trout Creek') and trimmed of field restatements.
